name: New Style 3 — Documentary
look: A premium streaming-documentary look where real archive footage carries the picture and quiet, expensive-looking scenes — maps, real headlines, photo spotlights, cut-out objects, calm cream-and-gold serif graphics — land exactly on the words.
tagline: Real footage first; quiet cream-and-gold scenes exactly on the words.

devices.use: a new place or time begins: PLACE, a gold rule, the date (over the blurred real picture)
one figure that matters, counting up, its unit, what it means and its source
a comparison with real numbers: 2-6 bars on warm paper, the one that matters highlighted, source under
3-5 dated events on a line the camera travels along
a documented quote, word by word, with who said it and when
one short serif line where the story turns
the question the next part answers
where it happens (the template's map colours)
a real photo of a person named, in a pool of light
a person's name over footage (bottom-left caps, gold rule, role in serif italic) - every public person named; private people get a label, never a photo
a place / date stamp top-left over footage (a dateline at the same moment as a map becomes the map's subtitle instead)
a figure counting up over footage, bottom-left, with what it counts
a key term the viewer must remember (one or two a video): dark caps on a gold box
the match cut, ONCE a video, on the first naming of the main person: photos=[{img, face:[x, y, height] as fractions}]
the text match cut, once a video where facts pile up (not within 20 s of the match cut): lines=[1-4 words x 3-5], photos=[...]
the real headline page behind a claim: img (a screenshot of the real page), url, marks=[{box:[x0,y0,x1,y1], at}], source, move window|paper|scan
a paper-collage moment (7-14 s as 2-4 s shots): halftone cut-outs of the real people, torn photos, typed strips, stamps, red number cards, pins and string

rules: Real footage carries it (58 % of the hook, 60-65 % of the body), cut sentence by sentence - a new real shot about every 4 s, never looped; a repeat >= 30 s later, reframed. No stock, no AI pictures unless asked.
Hard cuts only (xfade 0) - no dissolves, whips or leaks as transitions; a whoosh on the cut into every scene, a softer one out.

Scenes land on the words: a map when a place matters, a dateline on a new date, the real headline page on a reported fact (empage), a spotlight / depth push on every public person named, cut-out objects, a paper-collage moment inside the first 30 s.

Labels on footage, 3-5 a minute (>= 5 in the first minute): names bottom-left (emname), places / dates top-left (emplace), figures bottom-left (emfigure); never over a graphic, map, page or collage; 2.2-4.5 s each.

Graphics add a fact the voice does not (dateline, number with source, chart of 3+ things, timeline, documented quote, pivot / question at a real turn); one about every 45 s; never the same type twice in a row.
Captions: still, one line <= 48 chars, Roboto Condensed 46 px, bottom-centre, hidden over graphics, maps, pages and collage (docu/captions.py burns them at `final`).
Grade eq=contrast=1.04:saturation=0.94:gamma=0.99, no vignette on footage, a faint dust bed; 1-2 warm leaks only on emotional shots.
The full spec: templates/emerge-documentary/pack/EDITING-STYLE.md and EDIT-PLAYBOOK.md (read both before writing the shot list).
